scripts.build: npm run build -w @educa/shared && npm run build -w @educa/nucleo && npm run build -w @educa/api && npm run build -w @educa/realtime && npm run build -w @educa/despachante && npm run build -w @educa/worker && npm run build -w @educa/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json && tsc -p infra/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings=0 && node tools/guardas/lint.ts && npm run guarda:camadas
scripts.guarda:camadas: depcruise --config tools/guardas/camadas.cjs apps packages tools infra e2e
scripts.ops:sessao-sintetica: npm run -s build -w @educa/shared && npm run -s build -w @educa/nucleo && npm run -s build -w @educa/api && node --env-file=.env.example apps/api/dist/ops/sessao-sintetica.js
